name: Squircle Gallery
description: Grid of squircle-clipped, sepia-toned photo tiles where one tile is expanded with a caption. Clicking any tile swaps it into the featured spot using view transitions.
contents: Grid of image tiles clipped to a squircle shape
One featured larger tile with gradient overlay and animated title caption
behavior: Clicking a tile swaps it with the active tile, animated with the View Transitions API when supported
Inactive tiles are sepia and become full color when active
Images zoom from rest scale to hover scale on hover
Caption bounces in with a custom linear easing
Grid switches between mobile and desktop column and span settings at a breakpoint
editableByProps: Photos, titles and starting featured tile
Grid columns, row heights, spans, gaps, max width and breakpoint
Sepia amount, zoom levels, transition durations
Caption font, size, color and overlay color
fixed: Appends the caption font stylesheet link to document head and leaves it in place on unmount
Click swap animation needs View Transitions API support, otherwise it swaps instantly
